figures.title: From the row to five stories retold, step by step
figures.caption: Seven agent steps in under fifteen minutes; no person step. IPMA's message, 22 minutes before the first step, is not a step of the record.

claims.text: IPMA sent the change at 07:16:30; the row s-1111T0738 was written at 07:38:47, 22 min 17 s later, from the meteorologist's read in the other repository.

07:39:58: "authorities unchanged" from the open-data feed alone; 07:40:49, 51 s later, the same agent's correction naming the cause.
07:41:05: the media desk's twelfth keyed fact; no press report it could read by 07:42.
